items.docs:
Returns the scanner list.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.READ`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.READ`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.READ`. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Returns details for the specified scanner.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.READ`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.READ`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.READ`. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Updates the specified scanner. You cannot use this endpoint to assign the scanner to a network object. Instead, use the [POST /networks/{network_id}/scanners/{scanner_uuid}](ref:networks-assign-scanner) endpoint.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.EDIT`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.EDIT`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.EDIT`. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Deletes and unlinks a scanner from Tenable Vulnerability Management.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.DELETE`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.DELETE`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.DELETE`. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: scanner_id
params.description: The ID or UUID of the scanner. You can use the default UUID `00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000000000000000000001` to retrieve your container's current linking key.

Retrieves the key of the requested scanner.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the `VM.VM_SENSOR.LINKING_KEY.READ` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Lists AWS scan targets if the requested scanner is an Amazon Web Services scanner.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.READ`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.READ`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.READ`. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Lists scans running on the requested scanner.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.READ`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.READ`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.READ`. See [Roles](doc:roles).
